title: Tax books
summary: See each asset's tax value under a tax regime.

steps.text: {title} shows the tax value of each asset under a tax regime, year by year. A tax regime comes from a country module; until one is installed and chosen, the page says so and links to Modules. A category or election set here changes the open years only, and these figures never post to the ledger.
You can also ask the assistant for an asset's tax value or the tax depreciation for a year.

actions.value: What is the tax depreciation for last year?
